title: Developer Sales Playbook
audience: Developers who generate conversations but need a more reliable sales process.
shortDescription: Turn qualified conversations into signed projects.
coreOutcome: Run buyer-focused sales conversations from qualification through decision.
problem: Technical fluency does not automatically create a clear buying decision.
situation: Good-fit conversations stall, drift into unpaid consulting, or end without a clear next step.
commonFailure: Explaining the solution too early can hide the business problem, decision process, and fit risks.
methodology: Qualify the problem, understand consequences and constraints, establish fit, and guide an explicit next step.
capabilities: Connect technical work to business priorities
Advance or close out each opportunity clearly
whoItsNotFor: Anyone seeking pressure tactics or guaranteed closes

seo.title: Developer Sales Playbook | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: A practical sales system for turning qualified development conversations into clear decisions.
